corrections.original: Reuse an Approved AI Twin
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Choose an AI Presenter

corrections.original: You cannot film every ad yourself. Build an AI twin with your face and voice, then ship more ads without another shoot. Start from [spokesperson videos](/ai-video-generation/ai-actor-product-ads).
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Choose an available AI presenter for your product introduction. Add your own product photo and script, then review the generated shots before assembling your video.

corrections.original: Build an AI twin with your face and voice, then publish more often without burning out.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Create presenter-led product videos from your own photos and scripts. Save drafts, refine the storyboard and review the result before posting.

corrections.original: Rebuild a Winning Ad Style
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Plan Your Own Creative Direction

corrections.original: Found an ad style that already sells? Rebuild that look, swap in your item, and ship your own version in a few minutes.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Use product examples to plan your own scene, message and shot sequence. Add your own product assets and refine the storyboard before generating.

corrections.original: Talk to the video agent the way you would brief a teammate. It writes the script, sets the actor and the voice, and finishes the edit.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Describe your product and message in a short brief. Save a draft, generate its storyboard, refine the shots and assemble the versions you choose.

corrections.original: Drop a public product link. The photos and the description come with it, and a finished ad comes back. Open the [page-to-ad tool](/ai-video-generation/url-to-video).
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Import a public product page, review the details and available photos, then use the confirmed information in an editable video draft. Continue in the [page-to-ad workspace](/ai-video-generation/url-to-video).

corrections.original: Choose from five video formats: 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Choose from supported video formats, including 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9. Availability depends on the selected model.

corrections.original: A Reel wants 9:16 and a feed post may want 1:1. 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 are on the same account, with no watermark. Post it straight to [TikTok](/platforms/tiktok-ads) or [Meta](/platforms/facebook-ads).
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Create videos in supported formats such as 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9. Check the available aspect ratios for your selected video or image workflow, then review the output before posting.

corrections.original: Upload a product photo or paste its link, choose an AI actor, and add your message. Then generate the ad and download it in minutes.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Upload your product photo or import a public product page. Choose a scene and an available presenter, write your brief and save a draft. Generate and refine the storyboard, create the shots you choose, then assemble, review and download your video.

corrections.original: An AI UGC ad usually takes a few minutes. Add a product link, choose an actor, and download the finished video without arranging a shoot.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Timing depends on the selected model, video length, shot count and any revisions. You can save a draft, return from your Library and download the video after its shots are generated and the final render is complete.

corrections.original: Launch ads for a new product in a few minutes, with no creator and no studio. Test faster, drop the weak cuts, and scale the ones that sell.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Prepare product-video drafts without arranging a creator shoot. Compare creative directions, generate the versions you choose and review the results before launch.

corrections.original: Start with a plain phone photo. Minutes later, you have a creator-style ad ready to run.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Explore examples of how a product photo can guide a creator-style ad. Use your own product facts, then review the generated video before launch.

corrections.original: One plain bottle photo became a creator-style ad that feels like a real review. No creator to book, no shoot, ready in minutes.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: A serum product photo can guide a presenter-style introduction focused on the bottle and visible details. Review the generated product details and spoken claims before posting.

corrections.original: A Cozy Gift Ad in Minutes
corrections.suggestedEnglish: A Cozy Gift Ad Concept

corrections.original: Make high-converting ads that show the product, with no shoot, no creator, and no delay. Launch faster, test more ads, and keep the store running.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Create product-focused ads without arranging a traditional shoot. Prepare creative variations, review the generated details and test the content in your own campaigns.

corrections.original: Two sneakers on a counter became a lifestyle ad that looks filmed on location. No crew, no model fees, high-converting from day one.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: A sneaker product photo can guide a lifestyle ad concept with a presenter or product scene. Review the fit, shape and other generated details before using it in a campaign.

corrections.original: Add Your Logo and Type
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Review the Details Before Downloading

corrections.original: Put your mark on the end card and keep the type you use on the site. The last frame carries your brand into the ad.
corrections.suggestedEnglish: Check the generated product details, spoken words and supported captions before downloading the assembled video.
